units.source_text: 因此，苗子只知道千重子—其实她连千重子这个名字也不知道—同自己是双胞胎，但她是死是活、是姐姐还是妹妹都不晓得。

en.t: So Naeko only knew that Chieko, though in fact she did not even know the name Chieko, was her twin; she did not know whether she was alive or dead, or whether she was the older sister or the younger sister.

units.source_text: 因此她想，哪怕见一次也好；如果能见面，从旁瞧瞧也愿意。

en.t: So she thought that even seeing her just once would be enough; if they could meet, she would be content merely to look at her from the side.
